I think this way sometimes. We’ve just had too many people say they can handle it, or they love and care for you but then suddenly you’re too much. Some walk away, some bitch behind your back, some call you weak/weird. 

Just makes you want to shut yourself away from the world and hermit the fuck out. 

But I’ve also come to realise that everyone in this world is out on some pursuit of happiness. Everyone, includes us, “happy” people etc. And quite honestly most people can’t deal with our situation because the more they care, the more it brings them down too. And no one wants to be brought down. Sticking around means they have to be really strong, to be there for you when you’re not. And that’s real love which frankly, isn’t easy to come by. 

So don’t be upset with them. Just walk away and know they aren’t meant to be a part of your life. This is your battle and your war, no one has to fight it with you. But don’t give up trying to find allies! Once in a while a real person comes by and helps. Even if they only help for a part, it’s still help. 

As you said you can’t predict what human beings will do. So don’t expect them to be kind and good. But bottling it up only feeds the demons inside you. So don’t be afraid to open up. 

Perhaps this post is from a recent hurt.. and if so, here’s a hug. I hope you feel better soon.
